date: Nov 10, 2026 · Week 1 / Day 2 · Visibility & early risk communication

cards.title: Escalate the decision, not the plot
cards.question: PCIe Gen5 insertion loss drifts 0.4 dB across builds. When is this worth escalating?
cards.selfCheck: Tie the drift to remaining margin, sample variation and the next release gate. Exercise: state the decision at risk in one sentence, without declaring a failure.
cards.prompt: Coach a senior SI engineer on escalating a 0.4 dB PCIe Gen5 loss drift with uncertainty and a decision deadline.

cards.title: No surprise at layout freeze
cards.question: A via-stub fix needs routing changes two days before freeze. Who needs to know now?
cards.selfCheck: Notify layout, system SI, manufacturing and the program owner with options, impact and a decision deadline. Exercise: draft a three-line early-warning note.
cards.prompt: Role-play an early cross-functional warning about via-stub mitigation before PCB layout freeze.

cards.title: Say what the measurement cannot prove
cards.question: TDR sees a 55 Ω bump; EM predicts 53 Ω. Can you call the connector the root cause?
cards.selfCheck: No. State measured/model agreement, calibration and de-embedding limits, and competing explanations. Propose a discriminating test and time to conclusion.
cards.prompt: Challenge my confidence statement for a 55-ohm TDR discontinuity versus a 53-ohm EM prediction.

cards.title: Separate severity from confidence
cards.question: A 22 MHz PDN peak may overlap load-current energy. How do you prioritize it?
cards.selfCheck: Rate potential system impact and likelihood separately; compare ZPDN to target over the relevant bandwidth. Name the owner and fastest evidence that changes the priority.
cards.prompt: Teach a two-axis severity-versus-confidence triage for a PDN impedance peak, with a short manager update.

cards.title: One update, three audiences
cards.question: Crosstalk is 3 dB above budget near a release gate. How do you brief SI, layout and PM?
cards.selfCheck: Keep one fact set, tailor the ask: SI validates coupling and margin; layout evaluates spacing; PM owns the gate decision. Finish with a shared checkpoint.
cards.prompt: Quiz me on three concise audience-specific updates for a crosstalk over-budget finding, then critique clarity and ownership.
